classification.cubic: classical live cubic-history FOM warm start
classification.dynamic: classical FOM warm start; live cubic plus one target-grid exact-upwind residual and exact Helmholtz inverse; not learned and not NM-ROM

config.preconditioner: exact target-grid Helmholtz for both FOM finishes
config.timing_estimator: median paired repetitions within trajectory, then median trajectories
config.confidence_interval: 20000-draw trajectory-cluster bootstrap of per-trajectory paired medians
config.timing_scope: warmed compiled online trajectory solve; includes dynamic construction and FOM finish; excludes compilation, loading, test/reference generation, and first-query latency
config.reference_solver_scope: offline dual exact-Helmholtz truth generation and direct counting equivalence only; online methods/tolerances/schedule remain unchanged
